data.one_liner: Collection of useful extensions, helper classes, and widgets for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides helpful extensions for String, BuildContext, List, and DateTime, along with helper classes and widgets like EasyFutureBuilder and EasyStreamBuilder to reduce boilerplate code.
use_when: You want to write cleaner and more readable code using Dart and Flutter extensions.
You need quick helper utilities for adaptive layouts, theme checks, and string validation.
avoid_when: You prefer to keep your project strictly dependency-free of general-purpose utility packages.
You only need a single isolated utility and want to avoid importing a broad helper library.
strengths: Reduces repetitive boilerplate code across projects.
Includes useful adaptive and navigation helpers on BuildContext.
Bundles convenient date, list, and string validation extensions.
weaknesses: Package is still in early stages.
Broad set of disparate utilities may pull in unneeded abstractions.
